name: boringstack-admin
description: LAN-only operator dashboard for the BoringStack API (queue stats and the audit feed). No login: it talks to the admin API, which acts as the operator resolved at boot.

scripts.validate: bun run check && bun run test && bun run build && bun run size:check && bun run check:size-budget
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run typecheck:native

//overrides._: Why these transitive deps are pinned. Dev tooling only — lighthouse/lhci and http-server pull the vulnerable ranges; production output is a static bundle. Astro-only build deps (e.g. devalue, GHSA-77vg-94rm-hx3p) are pinned in apps/docs, not here — the Vite toolchain does not pull them.
//overrides.body-parser: Pin patched body-parser (GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828; earlier GHSA-v422-hmwv-36x6). 1.20.8 and earlier are vulnerable; 1.20.9 patches it. Transitive via @lhci/cli (CI-only).
//overrides.js-yaml: Pin patched js-yaml (GHSA-52cp-r559-cp3m, GHSA-5p4m-2wfm-xmqj, GHSA-2883-xcg3-v3hh). 4.3.1 and earlier are vulnerable; 4.3.2 patches the maxTotalMergeKeys CPU-exhaustion case. Build-time config loading only.
//overrides.postcss: Pin patched postcss (GHSA-r28c-9q8g-f849, GHSA-fxqj-rqcc-2cmp). 8.5.18 is vulnerable; 8.5.23 patches it. Build-time CSS tooling via vite/tailwind.
//overrides.seroval: Pin patched seroval (GHSA-9wx9-5pv9-3349, GHSA-f86p-h4j2-7qgj; earlier GHSA-p6vx-979v-rg4c, GHSA-jp82-f5mq-hwhp). 1.6.10 and earlier are vulnerable; 1.6.11 patches them. Reached only through solid-js under @tanstack/react-query-devtools, which is not in the production bundle.
//overrides.seroval-plugins: Moves with the seroval pin above; seroval-plugins declares a peer on the matching seroval line.
//overrides.ws: Pin patched ws (GHSA-58qx-3vcg-4xpx) pulled via lighthouse dev tooling; mirrors the docs app pin.
//overrides.qs: Pin patched qs (GHSA-6pq8-jhm2-2vcw; earlier GHSA-q8mj-m7cp-5q26, GHSA-4mjr-xmp4-gh2g, GHSA-x5fp-wj9c-mxmx). 6.16.0 is vulnerable; 6.16.2 and 6.17.1 patch it. Pulled via dev tooling.
//overrides.tmp: Pin patched tmp (GHSA-7c78-jf6q-g5cm type-confusion path traversal); 0.2.6 is now vulnerable, 0.2.7 patches it. Transitive dev-tooling dep via @lhci/cli. Mirrors the docs app pin.
//overrides.undici: Pin patched undici 7.30.2 (GHSA-2m5v-pch6-74hx, GHSA-4w7w-5xrc-9h26, GHSA-qrxm-fqhp-jwvm, GHSA-xjj6-f33q-929c, GHSA-4qv8-2p9j-2685, GHSA-55wc-3pg8-jfw6, GHSA-9fm3-97px-rjf6, GHSA-f72v-6w45-q472). 7.29.1 is vulnerable; 7.30.1 patches them. Build and CI tooling only.
//overrides.basic-ftp: Pin patched basic-ftp (GHSA-5pm8-86m8-9m6r, GHSA-r4jh-29pc-gfqr; earlier GHSA-c475-qrg2-pj4r). 6.2.3 and earlier are vulnerable; 6.2.4 patches them. Transitive via proxy-agent -> get-uri in the puppeteer / Lighthouse CI tooling.
//overrides.compression: Pin patched compression (GHSA-vc2v-76pw-4v95). 1.8.1 is vulnerable; 1.8.2 patches it. Transitive via dev/CI server tooling (http-server, Lighthouse CI); never in the static bundle.
//overrides.ip-address: Pin patched ip-address (GHSA-rxp7-6hxx-x8q5). 10.7.3 and earlier are vulnerable; 10.7.4 patches it. Transitive via proxy tooling; CI-only.
//overrides.proxy-addr: Pin patched proxy-addr (GHSA-jqcg-44mw-7w3h). 2.0.7 is vulnerable; 2.0.8 patches it. Transitive via express in @lhci/cli (CI-only).
//overrides.shell-quote: Pin patched shell-quote (GHSA-pqg4-j6r4-53mv). 1.10.0 is vulnerable; 1.11.0 patches it. Transitive via launch-editor (dev tooling).
//overrides.smol-toml: Pin patched smol-toml (GHSA-r4xh-jqrq-34v2). 1.8.0 is vulnerable; 1.9.0 patches it. Transitive via knip (lint-time only). Mirrored in every app by the override-parity rule.
//overrides.source-map-js: Pin patched source-map-js (GHSA-68fv-2mgg-jv7q). 1.2.1 is vulnerable; 1.2.2 patches it. Transitive via postcss / css-tree build tooling. Mirrored in every app by the override-parity rule.
//overrides.@types/react: Single React types resolution across the workspace.
//overrides.@types/react-dom: Single React DOM types resolution across the workspace.
//overrides.@typescript-eslint/utils: Match the API app's pin so the shared ESLint plugins resolve one utils version.
//overrides.react: Single React runtime across the workspace. zustand declares react as an exact-pinned optional peer, so without this it keeps its own nested copy when the top-level react bumps — two React instances break hooks ("Cannot read properties of null (reading 'useCallback')") in tests. Keep in lockstep with the react dependency.
//overrides.react-dom: Mirror the react pin so the renderer never drifts from React itself ("mismatching versions of React and the renderer").
//overrides.systeminformation: Pin patched systeminformation (GHSA-3f7j-7jwc-fxfj, GHSA-7648-jmwf-vw7j, GHSA-4vjg-vx72-qq4g). Releases before 5.33.16 are vulnerable. Transitive via dev and observability tooling.
//overrides.micromatch: Pin patched micromatch (GHSA-952p-6rrq-rcjv ReDoS). 4.0.5 is vulnerable; 4.0.8 patches it. Lint and build tooling only.
//overrides.minimatch: Pin patched minimatch (GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249, globparts amplification DoS). 7.0.0 to 11.0.0 are vulnerable and no 9.x or 10.x backport exists. Lint and build tooling only (eslint, typescript-eslint, glob).
//overrides.glob: Pin patched glob (GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4, AbortSignal cancellation bypass). 9.0.0 to 14.0.1 are vulnerable; 14.0.2 patches it. Build and CI tooling only.
//overrides.esbuild: Pin patched esbuild (GHSA-67mh-4wv8-2f99, dev-server request forgery). drizzle-kit's @esbuild-kit loader asks for 0.18.x, which is vulnerable; 0.25.0 patches it. Dev tooling only.
//overrides.launch-editor: Pin patched launch-editor (GHSA-587h-7wmj-h5pm, GHSA-698v-4r3x-3vcv, GHSA-r825-w8mm-5pxw). 2.14.1 is vulnerable; 2.14.2 patches it. Dev-server tooling only.
//overrides.fast-uri: Pin patched fast-uri (GHSA-w74x-v6f9-j3xg, GHSA-wjr9-j795-jxcr, GHSA-333x-w4r6-6crp, GHSA-xhq7-xmqj-769h). 3.1.8 is vulnerable; 3.1.9 patches them. Transitive via ajv in build tooling.
//overrides.yaml: Pin patched yaml (GHSA-48c2-rrv3-qjmp). 2.0.0 to 2.8.2 are vulnerable; 2.8.3 patches it. A lint plugin pins 2.4.1 exactly; config loading at build and lint time only.
